subject: Output of a CFA using ULSMVS estimator

messages.author: b0bcf6fb873d9992
messages.subject: Output of a CFA using ULSMVS estimator
parts:
Hi,

I conducted a CFA where I have categorical variables. I used the estimator ULSMVS, here is the code: 

fit <- cfa( model, data, estimator="ULSMVS", test="Satorra.Bentler", parameterization="theta", ordered =c("EFF_coll1","EFF_coll2","EFF_coll3","EFF_coll4","EFF_coll5","EFF_coll6","EFF_coll7","EFF_coll8","EFF_coll9","EFF_coll10"))

And the following is the output:

lavaan (0.5-23.1097) converged normally after  65 iterations

  Number of observations                           678

  Estimator                                                  ULS         Robust
  Minimum Function Test Statistic              145.211    619.101
  Degrees of freedom                                 35            15.364
  P-value                                                     NA           0.000
  Scaling correction factor                                           0.235
    for the mean and variance adjusted correction

My question is: why is R not able to compute the P-value for the Minimum Function Test Statistic? And how does the Robust work?

Thanks in advance!

Sarah
